physical_explanations.kurtosis: Measures signal tail peakedness. Spikes (> 5.0) indicate localized impact shocks from race or ball defects.
physical_explanations.rms: Measures total vibration kinetic energy. Increases monotonically with fault severity and spalling surface damage.
physical_explanations.crest_factor: Ratio of peak amplitude to RMS. Sensitive to early-stage transient impacts before overall energy increases.
physical_explanations.dominant_frequency: Identifies primary spectral peak corresponding to bearing impact frequencies (BPFI, BPFO, BSF).
